$schema-note: Adapter inputs for one corpus build. `corpus build --inputs <path>` reads this file. Every `inputPath` and `streetIndex` is relative to $MAILWOMAN_DATA_ROOT, or to $MAILWOMAN_CACHE_ROOT when the entry states `"root": "cache"`, resolved at launch.
$draft-note: A draft for the next build, written 2026-11-17 and not yet built. The rebuilt and new sources replace or join their v0.8.19-overlay files in an overlay on that corpus.
$overlay-note: `usgov-nad` is rebuilt because its adapter now labels a place column that writes the record's own county as `subregion` (`1 1st Street, Polk County, OR 97347`). Over release 24 that relabels 243,004 of the 90,566,949 rows with a state, a ZIP Code and a place value. The adapter's code digest changes, so v0.8.19's NAD run can't be resumed. It reads the v0.8.18 street index, as v0.8.19-rebuild did, so the relabel is the run's only change. A v0.8.19 index doesn't exist yet. Every other v0.8.19-overlay source is carried unchanged.
$recipe-outputs-note: This file names adapters only: `readBuildInputs` reads `adapters` and nothing else, and a recipe output reaches a corpus through `mailwoman corpus recipe` and the overlay, as every recipe output in v0.8.19 did. The recipe outputs this build adds are therefore recorded here as the invocations to run, each writing an `.invocation.json` beside its output under `corpus/recipe-outputs/`. `us-county` writes three new sources. `invented-house-venue` replaces both v0.8.19 files, `corpus-v0.8.0/invented-house-venue.parquet` and `corpus-v0.8.1/invented-house-venue-intl-v27.parquet`, which predate the record-id repair of #2894 and record neither the tuples nor the limit they were built from.
